blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Rain and cloudy skies are expected to affect several areas in the country on Monday, the state weather bureau said. In its latest weather forecast, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said the northeast monsoon, or amihan, will bring rain over Batanes and the Babuyan Islands, while the shear line is expected to affect Cagayan Valley.
